def transform(grid):
    cells=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==8]
    r0=min(r for r,c in cells); r1=max(r for r,c in cells)
    c0=min(c for r,c in cells); c1=max(c for r,c in cells)
    shape=[[1 if grid[r][c]==8 else 0 for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    return [[8*x for x in row+row] for row in shape]

if __name__ == '__main__':
    g=[[0,0,0,0,0,8,8,0,0],[0,0,0,0,0,8,0,8,0],[0,0,0,0,0,8,8,0,0],[0]*9,[4,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0],[0]*9,[0]*9,[0,0,0,4,0,0,0,0,0],[0]*9]
    print(transform(g))
